chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Three are from the signs of the believer: knowledge of Allah, and whom he loves and whom he dislikes.
ai.seo_question: What are the three signs of a true believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi identifies the triad of gnosis (ma'rifah), love (mawaddah), and dislike (mubahadah) as the definitive markers of a true believer. In Shia scholarship, these are not merely emotional states but are rooted in theological knowledge, where one's affection and aversion are correctly directed according to divine alignment. This framework underscores the integration of intellect and emotion in the spiritual journey of the mu'min.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Three are from the signs of the Momin – The knowledge in Allahazwj, and whom he should love and whom he should dislike’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah Who has said the following: “
Three things are of the signs of a believer: having knowledge of the existence of Allah, who to love and who dislike.”
